name: gdn_mega_bwd_extensive_v6
notes: Backward uses full recomputation and includes allocation/enqueue in synchronized wall time.
Forward saves no caches and uses preallocated buffers; ratios use synchronized wall time, not graph/device timing.
TP divides both head counts per device; communication is excluded.
Forward is unsupported for local value heads 2, 4 and 6: 60 measured forward configurations, 20 N/A.
Backward and forward were measured in separate processes; five samples per configuration.
